ledger.x: 983: the Slav rising founds the Lutician federation.
991: the Havel country at Brandenburg is fought over.
993: the Saxon army is victorious at Brandenburg.
1093: Henry of the Obotrites subdues the Lutician areas north of the Havel.
1128: the Lutician primores convert to Christianity and the contest closes.
1157: the Margraviate of Brandenburg is the successor.
1157: the Lutician lands are shared out.

wars.name: Slavic revolt of 983
wars.outcome: The rising of the Obotrites and Veleti ended the Billung March and the German hold east of the Elbe; the Lutici appear in the written sources in this context.

wars.name: German-Polish War (1002-1018)
wars.outcome: The Lutici entered an alliance with the emperor against Bolesław I of Poland on 28 March 1003; the Peace of Bautzen of 1018 ended the war and the Lutici attacked the Obodrites in the same year.

wars.name: Wendish Crusade
wars.outcome: The Wendish Crusade of 1147 targeted the Obodrite and Lutician areas.

certainty.note: The federation's extent is described by rivers; it was a loose federation of tribes whose control varied.
